strategyThesis: Productize one segment with a fixed service boundary to convert bespoke custom AI consulting into a repeatable managed service, thereby increasing recurring revenue and reducing delivery variability, while validating design partner acceptance within 90 days.

decision.text: Productize one segment with a fixed service boundary, selling three paid design partners within 90 days.
decision.label: human_decision

scope.text: Focus on one segment only; no new verticals or partner-led delivery this half.
scope.label: human_decision

alternativesConsidered: Remain bespoke and grow volume (Option A)
Productize one segment with a defined service boundary (Option B)
Partner-led delivery for the long tail (Option C)

strategicAlternatives.name: Option A: Remain bespoke and grow volume
strategicAlternatives.howToWin: Leverage existing capabilities and client relationships to increase volume

tradeoffs.text: Higher revenue potential but continued margin erosion due to lack of reuse.

strategicAlternatives.howToWin: Develop standardized offering with fixed scope, enabling asset reuse and predictable delivery

tradeoffs.text: May limit market reach but improves margin and delivery consistency.

tradeoffs.text: Requires upfront investment in productization and design partner validation.
